scope.summary: Implement the vector Distort & Transform live effects (V,T,G; CPU/No-GPU): Free Distort (four corner-point frame), Pucker & Bloat (anchor pull outward/inward, segments curve opposite), Roughen (jagged peaks/valleys, size/detail/smooth-corner), Transform step-repeat (live move/scale/rotate/reflect + copies count for procedural step-and-repeat stacks), Tweak (random segment curve/distort, relative/absolute), Twist (sharper rotation at center), Zig Zag vector (uniform jagged/wavy arrays, size/ridges/point-type). Operate on live geometry, bake-expandable.
acceptance_criteria: Free Distort, Pucker & Bloat, Roughen, Transform (step-repeat), Tweak, Twist, Zig Zag (vector)
expected_tests: test: Transform copies-count step-repeat stack; Pucker&Bloat/Roughen/Tweak/Twist/ZigZag geometry correctness; bake-expand

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Vector distort/transform + step-repeat live effects missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
